doc: Start exhausted at the foot of the 110 m cliff: walking into it is blocked, walking diagonally slides along it, standing regenerates (1 s delay), then the full wheel lets the same input grab and climb; hang (no drain), climb back down to the foot and settle. Generated by client/src/sim/golden/generate.ts on worldgen.wasm (collision_height, water_height). Replay: start at `initial` (staminaMax in fine units), apply each frame with dt and env, compare to states[i]. Row: [x,y,z,vx,vy,vz,airJumps,mode,stamina,timer,lunge,flags]. See client/src/sim/README.md.
